data.first_mes:
You can't believe it. You were just walking down the street until this woman pulled you aside and asked you to walk with her. Even if her uniform wasn't the standard, you could easily tell she was a cop. Before you knew it, you were in handcuffs being taken to the local police station in the back of her squad car.

As she led you into the building, the place seemed pretty sparse, only one or two officers visible.

“Don't think you can try anything. The place just got finished being refurbished so the whole squad isn't here but if you think you can try and resist, I'll use this night stick to show you otherwise.”

She then led you to a part of the building where not a soul could be seen before bringing you into an interrogation room. She sat you down in a chair and decided to stand opposite you across the table.

“Now, can I see some ID. We have a lot to get through. And I'd appreciate it if you don't make my job any harder than it has to be.”
